title: Retry only eligible failures
prompt: attempt is the one-based number of the attempt that just failed. Return true only if the failure is transient and another attempt is available below maxAttempts. Return false for attempt < 1 or maxAttempts < 1.
signature: bool shouldRetry(int attempt, bool transient, int maxAttempts)

tests.label: Another attempt remains
tests.hint: There is one remaining attempt after attempt two.

tests.label: Last allowed attempt
tests.hint: Use a strict comparison at the limit.

tests.label: Permanent failure
tests.hint: A retry budget does not make every failure transient.

tests.label: Invalid numbering
tests.hint: The first valid attempt number is one.

hints: Write the conditions as independent boolean rules.
A retry is available only when attempt < maxAttempts.
explanation: This policy separates “may another attempt help?” from “is the retry budget exhausted?” It does not itself repeat a request or make an operation idempotent.
chapterTitle: Containing Failure with Retries, Circuit Breakers, and Bulkheads
